## Toolkit

- **[P2] Keyspace setup failures lose warning visibility** — [connection_pool.rs:903](/tmp/review-bench-codex-code-review-ad-2026-10-17-CMsmSG/quillstone/scylla/src/network/connection_pool.rs:903). Failed initialization `USE` requests previously logged at WARN and now log at DEBUG. When existing connections remain, the error also stays out of shared pool state. At INFO/WARN, repeated refill failures therefore become invisible to callers and operators.

- **[P2] New regression test has unbounded waits** — [connection_pool.rs:1634](/tmp/review-bench-codex-code-review-ad-2026-10-17-CMsmSG/quillstone/scylla/src/network/connection_pool.rs:1634), repeated at line 1667. Both waits depend on a keyspace request without a local timeout. If that operation stalls, the test cannot reach its assertions or explicit proxy shutdown. Nextest supplies an external 120-second deadline; the PR’s documented `cargo test` invocation does not. This is a test failure-safety defect; the production timeout omission predates this PR.

## Standards

- **[P3] Both new keyspace tests omit tracing setup** — [connection_pool.rs:1474](/tmp/review-bench-codex-code-review-ad-2026-10-17-CMsmSG/quillstone/scylla/src/network/connection_pool.rs:1474) and line 1526. Neither calls `setup_tracing()`, despite [CONTRIBUTING.md:92](/tmp/review-bench-codex-code-review-ad-2026-10-17-CMsmSG/quillstone/CONTRIBUTING.md:92) directing new tests to do so. Isolated failures can consequently omit the required diagnostic tracing. The PR documents no exception.
